title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
abstract: arXiv:2610.40327v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radiological risk stratification and management planning are essential downstream tasks in medical imaging. Automating these tasks is challenging because clinical guideline criteria are distributed across prose, tables, and cross-referenced definitions. We present Guideline-derived Decision Graph (GDGraph), a framework that decouples guideline compilation from case evaluation. During compilation, a large language model partitions guidelines into section-based chunks, extracts local decision subgraphs with linked definitions, and aggregates related branches into an executable decision graph. During inference, a fast System One model answers localized clinical questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic, turning opaque single-pass predictions into a traceable decision path without task-specific training. Across 347 cases spanning renal cyst, adnexal mass, and thyroid nodule guidelines, GDGraph improves System One accur

translated_title: 基于放射学指南衍生的决策图用于高效临床决策支持
translated_abstract: 放射学风险分层和管理规划是医学影像中至关重要的下游任务。自动化这些任务具有挑战性，因为临床指南的标准分散在正文、表格和交叉引用的定义之中。我们提出了指南衍生决策图（GDGraph），这是一个将指南编译与病例评估解耦的框架。在编译阶段，大型语言模型将指南划分为基于章节的片段，提取带有关联定义的局部决策子图，并将相关分支聚合为可执行的决策图。在推理阶段，快速的System One模型回答局部化的临床问题，同时确定性遍历解析布尔逻辑，将不透明的单次预测转变为可追溯的决策路径，且无需任务特定的训练。在涵盖肾囊肿、附件肿块和甲状腺结节指南的347个病例中，GDGraph提高了System One的准确率……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了指南衍生决策图（GDGraph）框架，通过将临床指南编译为可执行的决策图，并结合快速System One模型与确定性图遍历，实现了无需任务特定训练、决策路径可追溯的高效放射学风险分层与临床决策支持。
en_tdlr: GDGraph is a framework that compiles clinical guidelines into executable decision graphs, combining a fast System One model with deterministic graph traversal to enable traceable, training-free radiological risk stratification and efficient clinical decision support.
